howToPlay.title: How to Play
howToPlay.content:
Mark Six is Hong Kong's most popular lottery game.

How to Play:
• Select 6 numbers from 1 to 49
• An additional special number is drawn
• Match your numbers with the drawn numbers to win

Prize Tiers:
• 1st Prize: Match all 6 numbers
• 2nd Prize: Match 5 numbers + special number
• 3rd Prize: Match 5 numbers
• And so on...

How This App Works:
We combine your name, Bazi, and birth location using traditional Chinese numerology to recommend number combinations that may bring you luck.
